name: codex-cli
title_zh: 什么时候值得把活交给 Codex CLI，跑多大
tagline_zh: 改一处高风险代码前，先想清楚是自己写还是外包给第二个模型：它帮你判断这次值不值、该开多大沙箱、给多少推理预算。
tagline_en: Before a high-stakes change, decide whether to write it yourself or hand it to a second model — and how big a run.
desc_en: When handing work to the Codex CLI earns its cost, and how to size the run: second-model review, bounded implementation hand-offs, sandbox permissions, model and reasoning effort. Use when the user asks for Codex or `codex exec`, when a change is complex or high-stakes enough that an independent reviewer would change the outcome, or when a delegated run needs its model, effort, or permissions chos
why_zh: 它不教你用 Codex，而是先算这笔账：独立评审能不能改变结论、任务边界划到哪、权限给到哪一档。
why_en: It doesn't teach Codex syntax; it prices the decision — will a second model change the outcome, where to cut scope, which.
limit_zh: 只做「要不要交、交多大」的判断，不替你写 prompt、不跑命令、不读 diff。
limit_en: Only judges whether and how big to delegate — no prompts, no runs, no diff review. Needs codex CLI installed and authed; low-risk tweaks it tells.
title_en: When handing work to Codex CLI is worth it
